name: Motion Reel
description: Full-screen WebGL video reel with shader transitions between three clips, a large serif title, a play button and chapter links that trigger the transition.
contents: Full-screen WebGL canvas showing three videos with a canvas-drawn fallback
Large serif title that slides up per variant
Intro paragraph and a round play button
Chapter list that switches between the three clips
behavior: Videos are tested and loaded, play button enables when ready
Pressing play fades the picture in from below
Chapter click runs a shader transition to the chosen clip
Falls back to animated canvas patterns if videos cannot load, and shows an error text without WebGL
Resets all frames, videos and GL resources on unmount

props.name: intro
props.default: Three short films on a single surface. Choose one and the picture folds into the next.

props.name: errorLabel
props.default: WebGL is not available in this browser.

editableByProps: Transition style, titles per style and transition durations
Intro, button and status labels, chapter names

needsCodeEdit.change: Add or edit a transition effect

fixed: Needs exactly three videos, extra entries are ignored
Uses the next/font Google fonts Bodoni Moda and Hanken Grotesk
Videos must allow cross-origin loading, otherwise the canvas fallback is used

options.look: A circular reveal expands from the center to bring in the next clip
options.useWhen: A film studio hero wanting a soft, focal transition between showreel clips

options.look: Vertical stripes slide the clips sideways past each other
options.useWhen: A sports or event landing page with energetic, quick cuts

options.look: Fine vertical ripples distort and dissolve one clip into the next
options.useWhen: A music or wellness hero needing a fluid, watery change

options.look: A twisting vertical wipe rotates the picture into the next clip
options.useWhen: A fashion or creative agency reel that wants a bold, graphic transition
